name: Arisegawa Arle
source:
Likes: Taking care of pets, reading, doing whatever she can while naked.

A very polite, very serious, very methodical, very rational mummy girl; first year. She doesn't like tight clothes on her body however, and apparently doesn't wear clothes at all. Even without clothes, her skin is incredibly sensitive, and she cannot walk comfortably because she's conscious about the clothes she's wearing. Although it's embarrassing for her because she finds it physically disagreeable, she has no choice but to tough it out whenever she goes outside. On a side note, having bandages wrapped around themselves is the formal dress for a mummy; in these modern times, only traditional families still wear them.

At school and in the dormitory, she takes care of pets as the sole member of the biology club. She feels at ease because animals don't care about being naked or not. Arle also can't sleep right with a different bed or pillow, so she brought over her personal coffin from her home. The coffin is fully equipped with both power and air conditioning: perfect for the ultimate lazing around.

"Animals don't have to wear clothes, so why can't we all stay naked...? Hah..."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/802870/The_Ditzy_Demons_Are_in_Love_With_Me/]Steam[/url]]
